faq.description: Everything you need to start creating viral dance videos.

items.question: What is AI Dance Generator?
items.answer: It's an AI tool that transforms any photo into a realistic dancing video. Upload a photo, pick a dance style, and get your video in under 60 seconds. No dancing or editing skills required.

items.question: What photos work best?
items.answer: Front-facing photos with clear face visibility work best. You can use selfies, baby photos, pet pictures, anime characters, memes, or even historical figures. Higher resolution = better results.

items.question: How fast can I get my video?
items.answer: Most videos are ready in 30-60 seconds. You can download immediately and post while the trend is still hot.

items.question: Will there be a watermark?
items.answer: No! All videos are watermark-free and exported in full HD 9:16 vertical format - perfect for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

items.question: What dances are available?
items.answer: We update our dance library weekly with trending moves: TikTok viral dances, Aura farming, K-Pop choreography, hip-hop, and more. Stay ahead of trends.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Each video costs 10 credits. New users get free credits to try it out. Check our pricing page for credit packages - the more you buy, the more you save.
